skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Gourmet
skins.content: 0011 New Release / Gourmet. FEater's outfit from a bestselling Lungmen foodie film. Incorporates a sporty inner layer and a traditional knotted jacked, once all the rage.
skins.quote: FEater wanted so much for the producers to add food scenes and chopstick fights to every film. Unfortunately, even though the audience loves this idea, the directors don't.

skins.name: Dojo Star
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line. A limited-edition outfit commemorating FEater's 3rd Anniversary of setting the box office record. Lightweight, breathable, and comfortably-fitting. However, anyone who knows FEater also knows that she has never worn this outfit properly.
skins.quote: Incidentally, the title of the movie is 'Divine Palm of the Phantom Godfist - Decisive Battle II'.
